talking_points: Microsoft is borrowing $25 billion to keep funding its AI data centre build-out, joining Amazon, Alphabet and Oracle in tapping bond markets.
Big Tech wiped out nearly $900 billion in value this week as investors grew nervous about AI capital spending paying off.
Canada and Nvidia have backed Cohere at a $35.7 billion valuation, while DoorDash is buying Instacart for $17 billion.
